_guide.HOW TO USE: Copy this file, replace every EXAMPLE/<...> placeholder, then run: npm run add:service -- path/to/your-copy.json (add --dry-run to preview). Delete the _guide block or leave it — it is ignored.
_guide.game: Game id — one of: ffxiv, wow, lost-ark, warframe, runescape. Must have a public/db/services/<game>/ directory.
_guide.subcategory: Id of an existing subcategory in that game's JSON (e.g. 'mounts', 'leveling'). The service is appended to it.
_guide.service.id: kebab-case, unique across all games, prefixed with the game id (e.g. 'ffxiv-my-service').
_guide.service.name: Card title shown in the grid.
_guide.service.tag1 / tag2 / tag3: Short bullet lines on the card. tag3 is optional — delete the line to omit it.
_guide.service.price: Fallback price in EUR (number >= 0). Use 0 when pricing comes from the engine / public/db/pricing/<game>/<Category>.json files.
_guide.service.image: Card image under public/images/ — convention: images/service-cards/<service.id>.webp. A missing file only warns (add it in the same PR); a path outside images/ fails.
_guide.service.tag: Optional card badge — one of: Popular | Hot | New | Best Value. Delete the line to omit.
_guide.service.longDescription: Optional long-form text shown on the dedicated subpage.
_guide.service.account: Optional — Accounts-category listings only: { region: us|eu|oc|jp, levels: combat-max|all-max, housing: none|small|medium|large, addedAt?: ISO date, specs?: string[] }.
_guide.subpage: Optional dedicated /boosting/<game>/<service.id> page. Delete the whole block for a category-only card.
_guide.subpage.rewardsHeading: Optional heading above the rewards (defaults to "Duty's Rewards").
_guide.subpage.gallery: Optional image gallery (account listings) — paths under images/ like service.image.
_guide.subpage.rewards[].icon: kebab-case icon name — see src/data/bundled/icon-names.json for the allowed list.
_guide.subpage.rewards[].dutyButton: Optional linked button under the title: { label, to: /boosting/<game>/<existing service id> }.
_guide.subpage.accordion: Mix of inline sections ({ title, items } or { title, groups: [{ heading, items }] }) and { "ref": "<slug>" } markers for shared sections — available slugs: see public/db/services/ffxiv/shared-sections.json (e.g. how-does-it-work, piloted-vs-afk-carry, piloted-boost).
_guide.PRICING: Flat-price services need nothing else. Services with methods/add-ons (piloted vs AFK, runs, …) also need a methodPrices (or engine config) entry in the matching public/db/pricing/ffxiv/<Category>.json.
